The load-bearing denominator is nevertheless false. D-134 already adopted the current SATISFIED-requiring set as D-002's 21 named affected rows plus DR-131 and DR-133, cardinality 23, preserving a nine-row deferral limb. D-365 counts only DR-128/129/130 as deferred and silently puts DR-106/108/109/110/113/116 back into slice 1 despite D-002 and later recordings explicitly deferring them. The correct current partition is 23 affected rows plus 9 deferred; among the 23, the status arithmetic is 6 SATISFIED + 14 OPEN + 1 DECIDED + 2 PROPOSED = 23.
